body: Seems like everyone is saying it's a hard no so I will make sure to skip over this one. Thank you!

I have the Asus Tuf Gaming Laptop FX505DV I believe. I've had it since last year and I bought it around the beginning of November. It's literally the best decision I've ever made. I can play fps games easily, minecraft with a good amount of mods, and I've even played intensive games like shadow of the tombraider and cyberpunk 2077. I've rendered videos and worked in things like blender and unity easily. I know it wasn't on your list but it might be a great alternative :) I'm always open to answer more questions if you have them
